name: savvy-teams
description: Companion to savvy-progress: the 'Lanes' task band above the prompt (one lane per task: state icon, agent, slim progress bar, active time; vector icons in an ocean palette on the desktop, theme-coloured text in the terminal), drawn only when a run-time guard confirms it can replace savvy-progress's row. Plus the lead and step rules (skipped for agents that carry their own or cannot call the step tool), a saved per-session bar that survives /resume, and auto-tracking when the lead forgets.

checklistBand.title: Checklist band
checklistBand.description: Draw the task checklist in place of savvy-progress's bar (only when the guard confirms it can; off = savvy-progress's own bar)

leadRule.title: Lead rule
leadRule.description: Add the progress-bar rule to the main session's system prompt

workerRule.title: Worker rule
workerRule.description: Tell every subagent that can call it to report its steps

autoTrack.title: Auto-track runs
autoTrack.description: Put subagent runs on the progress bar when the lead has not reported a plan

noStepAgents.title: Agents without the step tool
noStepAgents.description: Optional regex of agent types that get no step rule. Agents whose own file already has the rule, or whose tools list leaves out mcp__savvy-progress__step, are skipped by themselves.

teams.title: Team names
teams.description: Titles for auto-tracked bars, as regex=Name pairs split by ';' (for example ^yt-=Videos;^qa-=Checks). Empty: every bar is titled Agents.
